description: In front of you there’s a wicker basket of assorted foods on a red cloth, next to a light-colored plate holding a baguette and a dark plum. The right hand reaches in from the right, moves left toward the plate, grasps the plum as a right-hand object, lifts it up and carries it left over the basket, then lowers and releases it into the basket before the hand withdraws back toward the plate.
